summary: Liberty County tower; the Texas table dates it 1934 and says it moved to Kenefick in 1960, where it was removed in 1983; a 2011 map list still names an Oak Shade tower there.

facts.design: Tower; the table names EMSCO as manufacturer
facts.status_note: Listed as Gone on firelookout.org; the table has the tower at Kenefick from 1960 until its removal in 1983

events.note: Table's date column gives 1934 for Cleveland (Oak Shade)

Table gives 1983 as the removal year for the Kenefick entry, which says the tower came from Cleveland

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The 2011 map-based list still names an Oak Shade Fire Tower at these coordinates. The table and the lookout list say the tower moved to Kenefick in 1960 and that the site is gone. The record follows the table and the lookout list.

sources.title: TX expanded, Texas lookout tower table

notes_for_editor: The table rows for Cleveland (Oak Shade) and Kenefick agree on the move (to Kenefick on one row, fr Cleveland on the other), which is why confidence is medium. The table prints no units (the Height header has none, checked on the table page). The story gives 100 with no unit; height_m 30.5 assumes feet. The Oak Shade operator is not stated anywhere found; Kenefick is listed as Texas Forest Service. The 2011 list is a map-name compilation and is cited only to explain the old name, not as evidence of a standing tower. Tarkington Prairie appears only in the lookout list's name for the site; no source tied the tower to it. No staffing, fire, access or photo sources found. Two WebSearch calls were used.
